iterations.title: Native build — pure QML, harness-verified (11 states, 0 errors)
iterations.note: FoyerRoot.qml (1172 ln) + FoyerData.js: the entire v4 surface in native Qt6/QML, Kirigami.Theme runtime tokens (verified live: accent #569fcc, pos #7ea64b, neg #da4453 under Breeze Dark). Verified in the fleet nested-kwin harness: full plasmashell + private runtime dir + unique socket + PID-gated teardown; 11 states driven through a package-relative file channel (QML_XHR_ALLOW_FILE_READ), 12/12 transitions, zero applet errors, 11/11 unique frames; semantic pixel audit: system renders orange consequence rows (+267), fleet renders 13 green UP dots + red nas DOWN, rail 38px-pitch rows confirmed. Popup geometry proven unscaled 920×640 via corner beacons. Remaining: LayerShellQt daemon (needs layer-shell-qt-devel), live data wiring, kglobalaccel.

iterations.title: User-space daemon — PySide6 + layer-shell, no rpm-ostree
iterations.note: The C++ daemon needed rpm-ostree layering — redesigned to pure user space: /usr/bin/python3 + PySide6 (system rpm, same Qt 6.11 as the desktop) hosts the SAME FoyerRoot in a LayerShellQt Layer.Top window (org.kde.layershell QML module already on host). KWin assigns the full output; the 920×640 card centers inside (measured 916×636 @ (242,182)). DBus gdeyoung.foyer toggle/show/hide verified; systemd user unit Type=dbus gives the krunner warm-start pattern; hotkey via kglobalaccel [services] — Meta+Space takeover from hermes-menu is flag-gated, never silent. Blur dropped (PyKDE absent; 0.96α card carries the design). 13/13 unique frames incl. hidden (0 UI px) + reshow (byte-identical).
